parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing risk is mainly institutional, not criminalisation. The 2025 biological-sex interpretation and 2026 single-sex code, transport-police strip-search changes, stop-search guidance and prison/care policies expose an outed traveller to exclusion, humiliating searches and birth-sex placement; the documented cancer-ward delay shows life-threatening severity, though not every visitor will encounter it. Gender-reassignment anti-discrimination law and functioning courts remain, but they are displaced in spaces and no working traveller-specific remedy is documented; legal challenge/UN warnings unresolved. Lack of border rejection incidents and some tolerant urban climate reduce but do not offset tier-1 exposures. Rate as lower Elevated Risk due severe, state-imposed, universal possibilities without reliable recourse.
